fuzz {

_ = undef
_ = sil
_ = sil_stage
_ = sil_vtable
_ = sil_global
_ = any
_ =  sil_default_witness_table
_ = sil_coverage_map
_ = sil_scope
}

                    keyword(SwiftSyntax.Keyword.any) "any"
                    IdentifierType
                      wildcard "_"
        rightBrace "}"

              wildcard "_"
        rightBrace "}"
